name: Brainstorm
summary: Collaborative discovery and design framing for ambiguous or high-risk work. Use when requirements are unclear, multiple approaches are possible, or you need to turn an idea into a validated design brief before planning or coding.

name: Docs
summary: Create or refresh project documentation in `docs/`. Use when a project needs docs initialized or existing docs synced to the current codebase.

name: Execute Plan
summary: Execute an approved implementation plan exactly and safely. Use for ExecPlan-style plan execution, resumable phase checklists, multi-hour implementation work, migrations, significant refactors, and plans that require verification checkpoints, status tracking, and final reporting.

name: Quick Implement
summary: Rapid implementation for small, low-risk, well-defined changes. Use when the task is narrow in scope, has clear acceptance criteria, and can be completed safely without a formal multi-phase plan.

name: Write Plan
summary: Create detailed, execution-ready implementation plans for complex or high-risk changes without coding. Use for ExecPlan-style work, multi-hour changes, significant refactors, migrations, resumable phase checklists, and work that should be handed off to execute-plan with clear validation.
